evidence: arXiv 2406.09187, Xiang et al. (ICML 2025). Abstract: GuardAgent protects agents by "dynamically checking whether their actions satisfy given safety guard requests" and "maps this plan into guardrail code for execution."

Sec 4.1: PromptGuard 2 targets injections "originating from user inputs or tool outputs"; Sec 4.3.2 AgentDojo: no guardrail 17.6% ASR, combined PromptGuard+AlignmentCheck 1.75% ASR (utility 47.7% to 42.7%). No functional-correctness checks.
correction: The quoted 'fine-tuned BERT-style model' sentence is in Sec. 1 (Introduction), not Sec. 3; tool-output scanning is in Sec. 4.1/4.3.1. Say 17.6% to 1.75% is for the combined PromptGuard 2 + AlignmentCheck setup, with utility dropping from 47.7% to 42.7%. 'Does not check functional correctness' is our reading (the paper never addresses it), not a statement the paper makes.
